description: Current weather at the water, a modelled fishing-activity score (0-100), estimated water temperature and the best time window of the day. Values come from a weather model and are an estimate, not a guarantee of catch.

id.description: Page id of the water (from search_site or waters_near).

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

name: get_water_conditions
title: Current conditions at a water
